title: Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards Members on Ridgeline Pro Credit — Standing Reduction of the Monthly Late Payment Charge
content:
A business in good standing with Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards pays its Ridgeline Pro Credit statement late payment charge at a reduced monthly percentage. The standing reduction is set by the business's active ProBuild membership and by the account's late payment charge record.

## Standing reduction

| The business's active Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership | Other late payment charges posted on the account in the last 12 months | Standing reduction |
|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Gold, ProBuild Platinum or ProBuild Platinum Elite | No more than 1 | 0.50 percentage points (Gold standing reduction) |
| ProBuild Silver | No more than 1 | 0.25 percentage points (Silver standing reduction) |
| Any other case — 2 or more such charges, a ProBuild Member or Bronze membership, or no active membership | | Zero |

## How it is applied

The standing reduction is taken, in percentage points, from the tier's monthly late payment charge percentage; the monthly percentage the charge is computed at never falls below zero.

The other late payment charges counted are the late payment charges already posted on the account in the 12 whole calendar months counted back from the date the charge is assessed. The membership is the business's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership in active status, read by its tier name.

## Cases (hypothetical, Commercial Account Net 45 at 1.50 percent)

| Membership | Late payment charges in the last 12 months | Monthly percentage the charge is computed at |
|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Gold | 1 | 1.00 |
| ProBuild Gold | 2 | 1.50 |
| ProBuild Silver | 0 | 1.25 |
| ProBuild Bronze | 0 | 1.50 |
